author: ignaciope98
quote: The game is buggy as hell, but bugs get patched, so it's not the issue. The real problem: it's gay by design and terminally woke. The graphics don't justify it. Characters are flat, no charisma. It's The Sims: babysit Lucía, tidy the house, buy her flowers. Jason exists to serve her. A simp simulator. Gabe Newell said: we already write grocery lists in real life, and realism isn't fun. GTA V is 1000x better.
